description: Defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling gPTP (generalized Precision Time Protocol) messages, including message preparation, handling, and transmission functions.

methods.name: gptp_data
methods.description: Calculates the pointer to the gPTP message within a network packet.

methods.name: gptp_prepare_sync
methods.description: Prepares a gPTP Sync message for transmission.

methods.name: gptp_prepare_follow_up
methods.description: Prepares a gPTP Follow Up message.

methods.name: gptp_prepare_pdelay_req
methods.description: Prepares a Path Delay Request message.

methods.name: gptp_prepare_pdelay_resp
methods.description: Prepares a Path Delay Response message.

methods.name: gptp_prepare_pdelay_follow_up
methods.description: Prepares a Path Delay Follow Up message.

methods.name: gptp_handle_pdelay_req
methods.description: Handles received Path Delay Request messages.

methods.name: gptp_handle_pdelay_resp
methods.description: Handles received Path Delay Response messages.

methods.name: gptp_handle_pdelay_follow_up
methods.description: Handles received Path Delay Follow Up messages.

methods.name: gptp_send_follow_up
methods.description: Sends a gPTP Follow Up message.

methods.name: gptp_send_pdelay_req
methods.description: Sends a Path Delay Request message.

methods.name: gptp_send_pdelay_resp
methods.description: Sends a Path Delay Response message.

methods.name: gptp_send_pdelay_follow_up
methods.description: Sends a Path Delay Follow Up message.
